scope: Seven Precasia monster spawn-rule selections, direct biome resources and independent custom-predicate truth tables. Not live spawn tests or all Precasia creatures.

special_conditions: In Precasia at Y ≤ 50: the custom gate passes non-natural reasons, otherwise requires a random value below 0.05.
Above Y 50 in Precasia: requires Precasian Desert, sky-darkening ≥ 4 and random < 0.05 × effective difficulty. This branch has no natural-reason bypass.
In Precasia: Y ≥ 60 OR Y ≤ −13. The custom height gate has no natural-reason bypass; −12 through 59 fail this gate.

limits: Truth-table random values are synthetic comparison probes, not sampled RNG output; float32 comparisons and multiplication are modeled
All seven retain common day-or-night helper checks; a custom-gate result alone does not spawn an entity
Attercopus upper branch and Spinoledon custom height gate do not use the natural-reason bypass
A biome pool entry can still fail height/light/custom gates
No measured encounter percentages, guaranteed habitat occupancy or safe-zone claim
